title: Lp bound by influence
statement: Let $[?]$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $[?]$, and let a finite nonempty index set label an orthonormal basis of real functions on that set containing the constant-one function. For a positive integer $n$, let $f$ be a function on $[?]^n$ taking values only in $[?]$, and let $L_i f$ be $f$ minus its average over coordinate $i$. For every real $p\geq1$, the $p$th power of the product-measure $L^p$ norm of $L_i f$ is at most $2^p$ times the coordinate influence $\langle L_i f,L_i f\rangle$.
